# Version 4.150.2
> **Upstream bug-fix servicing** · Released August 5, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.150.2) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.150.2)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.150.2 is a servicing release with further upstream Skia m150 fixes.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Three rounds of chrome/m150 upstream bug fixes, including Ganesh fixes** — Three upstream bug-fix syncs from the chrome/m150 branch have been applied, including a dedicated round of Ganesh (GPU backend) fixes, pulling in stability and correctness improvements from the Skia team. ([#4663](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4663), [#4648](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4648), [#4561](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4561), [#4517](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4517))
